svg.title: Default touchscreen controls: Touch Default preset
svg.desc: Actual Descent 2 emulator screenshot with the bundled default touch overlay. Yellow editable callouts identify movement, firing gestures, guidebot, weapon selectors, and utility buttons.

g.text: Double-tap: fire secondary (movement continues if held)
Drag out to near the edges to keep turning
Double-tap and hold: fire primary (aiming continues)
track, song name, open music menu
Drag vertically to choose task; release to select
Hold, drag to a weapon, release
Hold, drag to a weapon, release

svg.text: Stick centers follow your first touch.
